A '''casket''' is an item occasionally dropped by monsters that are near oceans or bodies of water. It can also be obtained via [[big net]] [[fishing]], at a rate of about 1/128 at lower levels and 1/85.3 at higher levels. The [[Fishing spot (Civitas illa Fortis)|fishing spot]] in [[Civitas illa Fortis]] has around a 1 in 5 chance of rewarding a casket, making this one of the most reliable places to obtain them. It can be opened to receive a small amount of treasure. Wearing a [[skills necklace]] with at least one charge while [[Big fishing net|big net]] fishing will slightly increase the chance of finding a casket.{{CiteTwitter|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1574717183888072705|author=Mod Ash|date=27 September 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/99014|archivedate=20 December 2022|quote=Your chance of a casket from big net fishing [while wearing a charged skills necklace] is about 0.4 percentage points higher.}}

For ironmen, these can be a good early source of a [[Cosmic talisman]].

==Methods of obtaining==
*Found via [[big net]] [[fishing]], or by bait fishing in the [[Fishing spot (The Stranglewood)|Stranglewood]].
*Dropped by monsters such as [[Dagannoth]], [[Rock Crab]]s, [[Sand Crab]]s, [[Swamp Crab|Swamp Crabs]], [[Ammonite Crab]]s, and [[Frost Crab|Frost Crabs]].
*Possible reward from opening a [[mystery box]] from the [[Quiz Master]] [[random event]].
*Received as a reward from allocating workers to fishing in [[Managing Miscellania]]
*Salvaging [[Large shipwreck|large shipwrecks]] or [[Pirate shipwreck|pirate shipwrecks]]
